home.howTitle: What happens after you send your case

home.trustIntro: A few clear rules guide every case.

trust.title: Consultants make clinical decisions
trust.body: Diagnosis and treatment choices stay with the treating Consultant.

trust.title: Private document handling
trust.body: Reports go to private storage through short-lived links. Nothing is public.

trust.title: Your consent comes first
trust.body: Your case is reviewed only after you allow us to use your information.

trust.title: Emergency care comes first
trust.body: If your situation looks urgent, we will tell you to seek care where you are.

home.finalBody: Send what you already have. We'll guide you through the next step.
home.finalNote: Starting a case does not commit you to treatment or travel.
home.slogan: You see the full picture first. The decision stays yours.
home.areasIntro: Start with the area closest to your need. If you are not sure, send your case and your coordinator will direct it.

how.title: Your Care Journey, Clearly Coordinated
how.intro: From the medical information you already have to treatment and follow-up, RehletShifaa helps you understand each step and coordinates what comes next.

stages.title: Send your case
stages.what: Share the medical reports, tests, scans and information you already have.
stages.you: Share what you already have — a complete file is not required.

stages.title: Coordinator review
stages.what: Your Coordinator organizes the information and checks whether anything important is missing.

stages.title: Consultant review
stages.what: An appropriate Consultant reviews the medical information relevant to your case.
stages.you: More reports or clarification only if clinically needed.

stages.title: Your recommendation & proposal
stages.what: You receive the Consultant's recommendation together with the care proposal and estimated costs — what is recommended, the expected next steps, and whether further investigation may still be needed.
stages.you: Review it with your Coordinator, in your own time.

stages.title: You decide what happens next
stages.what: Nothing is arranged automatically. You review your recommendation and proposal, then choose whether to continue.
stages.you: If you continue: profile and account setup, and any coordination deposit explained first.
stages.next: Coordination begins only after your decision.

stages.title: Appointment & travel coordination
stages.what: If you decide to continue your care in Egypt, our Operations team coordinates the practical arrangements around your medical plan — appointment timing first, then travel support where required.
stages.you: Confirm the timing and the support you need.
stages.next: Everything is confirmed with you before you travel.

stages.title: Treatment & follow-up
stages.what: You receive care from the treating Consultant and facility according to the agreed medical plan.
stages.you: Attend your appointments; keep your Coordinator informed.
stages.next: Coordination continues through the agreed follow-up.
